subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The helicopter remains the dominant subject across most shots, but the sequence drifts from a parked side-view helicopter with a shirtless crewman into ghosted airborne helicopters and then a cockpit/interior view. The human subject from early shots disappears after shot 3.

background_coherent.rationale: Shots 0-3 share the same exterior helicopter/deck setting, but this is inconsistent with several captions. Shot 4 becomes a ghosted transition to a landscape/ship flight scene, and shots 5-6 move inside a helicopter in flight, so the broader military-aircraft event persists but the place continuity is only partial.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches the outdoor olive-drab helicopter, shirtless crewman, open side door, and archival military-deck look.
Caption asks for an indoor workshop/engine bay mechanic scene, but the frame remains outside beside the helicopter.
Caption asks for a close-up rotor/weather-vane-like device against the sky with no people, but the frame still shows the helicopter exterior and shirtless man.
Caption asks for an aerial naval-deck helicopter takeoff; the frame remains a close side view of the same parked helicopter.
Partly shows airborne helicopters/ship/terrain, but has heavy ghosting from the previous parked-helicopter shot and lacks clear formation structure.
Matches the dim helicopter interior viewed from behind a helmeted pilot, with exterior flight visible through windows.
Matches an in-flight view from inside an aircraft looking out at another helicopter over hazy terrain.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: Shots 0-3 collapse toward the same exterior helicopter setup despite captions requesting workshop, mechanical close-up, and aerial deck views. Diversity improves in shots 4-6 with flight and cockpit perspectives.

motion_continuity.rationale: There is plausible progression from walking/approaching the helicopter to equipment movement and then flight/interior views, but several sampled cuts feel like prompt drift or crossfade artifacts rather than clean continuous action.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 3 to shot 4 most visibly breaks continuity: a parked helicopter exterior turns into a ghosted aerial/landscape flight scene with double exposure artifacts.

cheat_flags.rationale: Early shots reuse the same helicopter side composition instead of following distinct captions. The subject stays centered in similar positions through shots 0-3, suggesting prompt collapse and positional bias rather than legitimate adherence.
